item.description: The Continuous-Time Service Network Design Problem (CTSNDP) arises in consolidation-based transportation systems, where shipments share paths in space and time to reduce cost. item.title: Normalized-step stochastic SQP methods for nonconvex constrained optimization under heavy-tailed noise
item.description: In this paper, we study nonconvex constrained optimization with expectation equality constraints and non-negative bounds under heavy-tailed noise. The objective gradients, constraint values, and constraint Jacobian are accessed through stochastic oracles whose errors have bounded $p$th central moments for some $p\in(1,2)$. item.title: Network flow-based cuts for binary bilevel programs
item.description: Binary bilevel programs are challenging to solve due to the lack of compact single-level reformulations. Recent extended network flow-based reformulations have emerged as a promising approach, providing strong dual bounds. However, their increasing size can make them computationally prohibitive. We develop a cutting-plane framework that exploits these networks without requiring an extended-space formulation. We introduce ... Read more
